inputs/ARM/inputs/inputs.json: 48 input records per arm, preserving exact source, curve, target, point manifest and coordinate positions
inputs/ARM/inputs/ID/: Original UTF-8 system.sing and input.json, copied unchanged from paired-r1
certificates/ARM-ID.json: Original input identity; status; optional lower/upper dreg bounds and dimension lower bound; binary six projection candidates and linear-top certificate, or checked prime formulas
candidates: name, retained zero-based variables, target quotient, successful/failed projection and every generator's top degree, term count, compact-JSON hash and surviving projected monomials. Failed candidates remain data, with no bound admitted.
monomial_encoding: Sorted lists of zero-based variable indices. Repetitions retain ordinary powers. Coefficient1 in F2. Top-term hash uses SHA256 of compact sorted JSON monomial array after cancellation and top extraction.
linear_top_certificate: F2 rank, echelon rows with pivot/variable indices, and XOR of original degree-one generator IDs. Original variable squares and these linear forms prove upper nvars-rank+1.
certificates/partial-summary.json: Progress snapshot after every case, periodically uploaded; no complete replay claim
certificates/summary.json: 96 producer rows with arm, target, nvars, point-manifest and source hashes, intervals/status, linear-top rank. Producer rows alone are not replay certificates.
replay.json: Fresh-process result for every input; all_verified plus source hashes/errors. This is producer replay, not independent scientific review.
status.json: Actual whole-producer and whole-replay exit codes; timeouts and partial files remain retained
manifest.sha256: SHA256 and relative path for every raw file except itself
instrument: Frozen native executable; hash pinned in protocol-top.json
retention: One deterministic top-runs.tar.xz plus .artifacts.json restores entire raw tree. Original paired-r1 inputs and prior evidence are unchanged. Unknowns remain null, not zero.
certificates/isomorphism-prime-ID.json: Sixteen prime paired graded-isomorphism certificates: source hashes, diagonal scale and inverse per variable, nonzero field-top multipliers and checked polynomial-map argument. Admitted only after both source certificates pass; replay recomputes and compares.
